blocks.html: TAK Replay records map events and chats in real time so you can replay them later. Open the plug-ins tab on the WinTAK toolbar to begin.

slides.title: Start recording
slides.html: Select Record to capture all map events and chats, or open the main TAK Replay panel (via Recordings) for more control. A recording can be paused, resumed or stopped from the toolbar.

slides.title: Choose a recording region
slides.html: When you select Record, choose what area to capture: Select Map View (only what's in view, with the zoom level preserved), Select Existing Shape, Select Polygon Region, or Select Rectangular Region. Use Reset Region Selection to pick a different region type.

slides.title: Record events & chats
slides.html: Select Start Recording, keep or change the title, and select OK. A tally shows the elapsed time and counts of events, map items and chat messages, updating until you stop. Toggle which items are recorded via Overlay Manager. Select Stop Recording to finish — the Timeline Viewer opens automatically.
